admission: Admitted only through a verified signed selection beside the released gRPC Caller Map claim 1.1.0, whose evidence it serves.

surfaces.ui: /impact?shape=operation_callers (reached from a protobuf operation in Contract Atlas or Caller Map)

required_inputs: the released gRPC Caller Map (phebs.grpc.caller.go claim 1.1.0) and its inputs
excluded: generated code whose .proto is not committed
generated code built from a .proto that has since changed
several equivalent committed copies of the same .proto
YARPC, Connect and other non-gRPC protobuf clients
gRPC calls through struct fields declared in another file
limits: Existing serving bounds; no bound widened; no new measured capacity or SLO.
